title: Expected distribution
view: Shared head base (visuals/distribution_bases/head): skeleton bust on the left, grey bust on the right, both turned three-quarters toward the image right so the patient's right cheek and right ear face the viewer; right-sided block.
teachingPoint: A supraorbital and supratrochlear block numbs the forehead, the anterior scalp to the vertex and the upper eyelid on one side.
claims: Skin (teal): forehead and anterior scalp to the vertex (to the coronal plane through the ear) and the upper eyelid to the lash line, lateral to the supratrochlear strip.
Skin (violet): the medial forehead strip, root of the nose and medial upper eyelid (supratrochlear nerve; the record's steps sweep medially toward the bridge of the nose).
Not shaded: the temple (auriculotemporal, zygomaticotemporal), the lower face and the other side; no bone is shaded.
Right-sided block (patient's right ear and cheek face the viewer); one tone per nerve, key shown under the image in the app.
